snippet.title: The Key to Home / いえのかぎ PV
snippet.description:
Sorry,  this visual novel "The Key to Home / いえのかぎ" was deleted by Valve.

Here is basically how everything has transpired so far.: http://steamcommunity.com/app/710370/discussions/0/1499000547482233373/
 
Now we are open to listening to your ideas and opinions on how we might fully correct this matter and bring this title back onto steam.
